defect: the world model battery averaged unrounded per test scores into its four distinctions while publishing the per test scores rounded to four places. An independent verifier recomputing a distinction from the sealed artifact got 0.9445 where the artifact stated 0.9444. Small, and the exact shape of a report that cannot be checked against itself
correction: the distinctions are averaged from the published rounded scores, so any reader can rederive them from the artifact. The report carries distinctions_are_recomputable_from_tests so the property is asserted in the artifact and not only in the code
reproduced_by: found by mop.cognition.verify recompute, which reads the sealed bytes and does the arithmetic by a second route without importing the module that produced them
rule: a reproduced defect overrides reviewer votes and becomes a permanent regression test
